description: Trafik och parkering is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Simrishamns kommun. Traffic and parking data for Simrishamn municipality. Coverage: Simrishamns kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic and parking" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Simrishamns kommun. Its keywords include trafik, parking, traffic, parkering. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
